summary: Publish immutable complete current agents views with epoch-local revisions

replay.detail: Only the latest current publication is retained. No history or replay transport is added.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or claim schemas change. Client contract definitions add publication metadata and a complete current view.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. Publication revisions identify node-local in-memory views.

compatibility.detail: Legacy HTTP and WebSocket grammars and HTTP response budgets are unchanged. No endpoint, transport opt-in or capability availability is added. A fresh read retains the failed-only fallback when no newer attempt is in flight.

downtime.detail: An ordinary binary upgrade restart starts a new publication epoch. No additional service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no configuration or state changes.

recovery.detail: Publications are process-local and disposable. Returning to the previous binary requires no database rollback.
